title: No Ender Spiders
description: This simple Datapack disables the spawning of the DivineRPG Ender Spider mob.
body:
This simple Datapack disables the spawning of the DivineRPG Ender Spider mob.

This is a feature often requested by DivineRPG community due to Ender Spiders being a difficult mob that can spawn in very small spaces. Instead of removing Ender Spiders from the DivineRPG though, we provide this optional datapack that disables their spawns.
